sn55.6:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū Bhagavato cīvarakammam karonti
sn55.6:1.3: Niṭṭhitacīvaro Bhagavā temāsaccayena cārikam pakkamissatī tī || || 3.
sn55.6:1.4: Tena kho pana samayena Isidattapurāṇā thapatayo Sādhuke paṭivasanti kenacid eva karaṇīyena ||
sn55.6:1.6: Sambahulā kira bhikkhū Bhagavato cīvarakammaṃ karonti
sn55.6:1.7: Niṭṭhitacīvaro Bhagavā temāsaccayena cārikam pakkamissatī ti || || 4.
sn55.6:2.1: Atha kho Isidattapurāṇā thapatayo magge purisaṃ ṭhapesuṃ ||
sn55.6:2.2: Yadā tvam ambho purisa passeyyāsi Bhagavantam āgacchantam arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ || atha kho amhākam āroceyyāsī ti || || 5.
sn55.6:2.3: Dvīhatīhaṃ ṭhito kho so puriso addasa Bhagavantaṃ dūrato va āgacchantam ||
sn55.6:2.4: disvā yena Isidattapurāṇā thapatayo tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Isidattapurāṇe thapatayo etad avoca ||
sn55.6:2.5: Ayaṃ so bhante Bhagavā āgacchati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho ||
sn55.6:3.1: Atha kho Isidattapurāṇā thapatayo yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā Bhāgavantam piṭṭhito pitthito anubandhiṃsu || || 7.
sn55.6:3.2: Atha kho Bhagavā maggā okkamma yena aññataraṃ rukkhamūlaṃ tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi ||
sn55.6:3.3: Isidattapurāṇā pi kho thapatayo Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdiṃsu || ||
sn55.6:3.4: Ekam antaṃ nisinnā kho te Isidattapurāṇā thapatayo Bhagavantam etad avocuṃ || || 8.

sn55.6:13.4: Yadā pana mayam bhante Bhagavantaṃ sunāma

sn55.6:14.1: Tasmā ti ha thapatayo sambādho gharāvāso rajāpatho abbhokāso pabbajā
sn55.6:14.2: alañca pana vo thapatayo appamādāyā ti || || 19.
sn55.6:14.3: Atthi kho no bhante etamhā sambādhā añño sambādhataro ceva sambādhasaṅkhātataro cāti || ||
sn55.6:14.4: Katamo pana vo thapatayo etamhā sambādhā añño sambādho sambādhataro ceva sambādhasaṅkhātataro cā ti || || 20.
sn55.6:15.1: Idha mayam bhante yadā rājā Pasenadī Kosalo uyyānabhūmiṃ niyyātukāmo hoti || ye te rañño Pasenadissa Kosalassa nāgā opavayhā te kappetvā yā tā rañño Pasenadissa Kosalassa pajāpatiyo piyā manāpā tā ekam purato ekam pacchato nisīdāpema || ||
sn55.6:15.2: Tāsaṃ kho pana bhante bhāginīnam evarūpo gandho hoti seyyathāpi nāma gandhakaraṇḍakassa tāvad eva vivariyamānassa yathā taṃ rājakaññānaṃ gandhena vibhūsitānaṃ ||
sn55.6:15.3: tāsaṃ kho pana bhante bhaginīnam evarūpo kāyasamphasso hoti seyyathāpi nāma thulapicuno vā yathā taṃ rājakaññānaṃ sukhedhitānaṃ ||
sn55.6:15.4: tasmiṃ kho pana bhante samaye nāgo pi rakkhitabbo hoti || tā pi bhaginiyo rakkhitabbā || attā pi rakkhitabbo hoti || || 21.
sn55.6:15.5: Na kho pana mayam bhante abhijānāma tāsu bhaginīsu pāpakaṃ cittam uppādetā ||
sn55.6:15.6: ayaṃ kho no bhante etamhā sambādhā añño sambādho sambādhataro ceva sambādhasaṅkhātataro cā ti || || 22.
sn55.6:16.1: Tasmā ti ha thapatayo sambādho gharāvāso rajāpatho abbhokāso pabbajā alaṃ
sn55.6:16.3: Catuhi kho thapatayo dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano ||
sn55.6:17.2: Idha thapatayo ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti ||
sn55.6:17.3: Iti pi so Bhagavā || la-pe || satthā devamanussānam buddho bhagavā ti ||
sn55.6:17.6: vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāram ajjhāvasati || muttacāgo payatapāṇī vossaggarato yācayogo dānasaṃvibhāgarato || ||
sn55.6:17.7: Ime hi kho thapatayo catuhi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano || || 25.
sn55.6:18.1: Tumhe kho thapatayo Buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti
sn55.6:18.2: Iti pi so Bhagavā || la-pe || satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā ti ||
sn55.6:18.5: Yaṃ kho pana kiñci kule deyyadhammaṃ sabban tam appaṭivibhattaṃ sīlavantehi kalyāṇadhammehi || || 26.
sn55.6:18.7: katividhā te Kosalesu manussā ye tumhākaṃ samasamā yad idaṃ
